about_short_description.short_description: Nurx is a digital healthcare company offering 10 services across reproductive health, at-home testing, dermatology, migraine care, and more.

product.name: Birth Control
product.description: Provides over 50 types of contraceptive methods including pills, patches, and rings, prescribed after an online consultation and delivered to the patient's home.

product.name: Emergency Contraception
product.description: Offers prescription and over-the-counter emergency contraceptive pills, including Ella and generic Plan B, available via online consultation and home delivery.

product.name: Mental Health Care
product.description: Delivers evidence-based treatment plans for anxiety, depression, OCD, and related conditions through online consultations, prescription medications, and ongoing provider support.

product.name: Acne Treatment
product.description: Provides personalized prescription acne treatments including topical and oral medications, prescribed after online evaluation and delivered to the patient.

product.name: Anti-Aging Treatment
product.description: Prescribes topical retinoid creams and combination formulations to reduce fine lines and wrinkles, based on online skin assessments and delivered to the patient.

product.name: Weight Management
product.description: Provides injectable and oral medications for weight management along with personalized guidance and progress tracking through online consultations.
